6.2 The cost of construction of One Stop Centre is .
stated to be Rs. 5,87,225/-, but the Assistant Engineer (PWD) has prepared the technical evaluation report, according to which, a sum of Rs. 2,20,819/- was spent.
of As such, a sum of Rs. 3,66,406/- was embezzled by Jitender Kumar (Contractor) and Jagdish Raj Rana rt (applicant) by preparing forged bills and entering the forged data in measurement book.
6.3 On the basis of above facts, the Police registered the case against the applicant.

6.4 On the basis of stand, so taken, by the Police, interim protection was awarded to the applicant on 24.7.2023 and thereafter, the Police has submitted the supplementary status reports, on various dates, mentioning therein that the accused named in the FIR were associated, in the investigation of the case.

6.5 It is the further case of the Police that the procedure with regard to the tender and award letter has not been followed, while constructing the boundary wall of .
One Stop Centre, Sarol.
6.6
During investigation, it was also found that the evaluation report of the boundary wall of One Stop of Centre, was signed by the Executive Engineer, HPPWD, Division-I.
It was also found that the evaluation report, rt so prepared, was forged.
Further, it has been mentioned that applicant Jagdish Raj Rana has joined the investigation.

6.7 In the status report, filed today, it has been mentioned that when the evaluation report was prepared, at that time, the District Programme Officer, Chamba, Jagdish Raj Rana (applicant) was on 15 days' earned leave and the charge of the District Programme Officer was with Shri Bal Krishan Sharma, Superintendent Grade-I and he has released an amount of Rs. 4,98,625/-
to the Contractor Jitender Singh, on 17.6.2020, for the construction of boundary wall of One Stop Centre.

7. On the basis of above facts, a prayer has been made .
to dismiss the application.
